parties.petitioner: Justice (Retd) Raj Rahul Garg (Raj Rani Jain) and Others
parties.respondent: Union of India, Ministry of Law & Justice

summary: Pension computation for former High Court Judge: break in service (54 days between district judge retirement and High Court appointment) contested; blending of district judiciary service with High Court service; distinction between Section 14 and Section 15 of High Court Judges Act; applicability of Part III Schedule; retirement pension calculation; service continuity for pension purposes
legal_provisions_cited: High Court Judges (Salaries and Conditions of Service) Act 1954 Section 14; Section 15; Part III First Schedule
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; pension calculation reverted to exclude blended service.
